name: Creta Electric cluster display (India, right-hand drive)
description: CRETA-SPECIFIC, right-hand drive, no guarantee for any other car. Android Auto on the Hyundai Creta Electric India cluster (SU2IEV.IND, 260430): left-hand traffic roundabouts, the car's near-turn scenes and countdown bar, destination side, compass after a route. Needs the Wireless mod.
